changes_made.explanation: Consolidated task descriptions to single 'Other:Question Answering' and simplified output description to avoid redundancy. The paper focuses on question answering tasks using multimodal RAG systems.
Normalized metric names to consistent capitalization and removed duplicates. PSI_p is a variant of PSI, so consolidated under main metric name.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. The models mentioned are used for generation, not for evaluating outputs.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The evaluation relies entirely on automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on position bias in multimodal RAG systems for question answering tasks. Evaluation is conducted using automatic metrics (Accuracy, PSI, N2E) without human or LLM-as-judge assessment. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of redundant task/output descriptions and normalization of metric names.
